purpose: Round-2 fresh DEVELOPMENT check set (Astra round-2 adoption). The original 24 (signal_set.json) stay as regressions; report the two sets separately. Once inspected, these items are development data. NOT an acceptance set, NOT a test set.
items_are: existing dataset items only (sim/dataset/general.json); no new instruction text was written
rule: Pool = split_manifest.nontest, reviewed, EN and FA text present, with a reference plan, status ok in sim/dataset/general_validation_FloorPlan1.json.

Excluded from the pool: the 12 signal items (24 presentations, also the rehearsal items); manifest exposed_items; practice order-0 items and the C3/W3 evaluation-B screen items (c3_split.json); manifest excluded_inapplicable; any item not ok in the FP1 validation.

Hard-kind label (first match): tool_only_purpose (L3, single pickup of a tool for a stated purpose), microwave_stay_inside (a Microwave is a plan type), fridge, cutlery (Fork/Spoon/Knife/ButterKnife/Spatula), else other_<level>.

Step 1, acceptance reservation (done first): inside each kind, seeded shuffle (master_seed 20261010, key seed:kind) and ids alternate between acceptance and fresh, starting side set by a seeded coin that flips per kind. Acceptance keeps up to 8 per level by a seeded hash order; overflow goes to spare (used by nobody).
Step 2, fresh: from the fresh side, per level, quotas L1 4, L2 5, L3 3; first one item per distinct hard kind (seeded hash order), then fill by the same order.

acceptance_reservation.purpose: reserved NOW so no dev work touches them; not to be opened, planned, or run until the package is frozen (A24 acceptance gate)
acceptance_reservation.shortfall_note: A24 asks 8 per level; the unused non-test L3 pool is too small. Arash/A25 must decide how to fill the L3 gap (held-out families, or a smaller L3 share). It is not filled with already-used items here.

honest_caveats: Package support: items marked cited_as_package_support appear in a support/tuned_on list of the procedure KB or L3 templates (nearly every non-test L2/L3 item does). The package builder already drops, per presentation, any record that cites the presentation item itself (item-level leave-out). Fresh is therefore self-support-free, not support-free; a family-level leave-out would empty the fresh L2/L3 cells.
Fresh items share families with practice/signal items (the non-test pool has 15 families). They are fresh as items and texts, not as families; do not call them held-out families.
EN and FA are the dataset texts as Arash checked them. The known EN/FA mismatch (g-l2-microwave-run-egg) is in the signal set, not here.

Coverage gaps: only 5 unused non-test L3 items exist, so fresh has 2 L3 items (one purpose-named tool request g-l3-tool-scrub, one indirect state request) and acceptance has 3; 11 items / 22 presentations, not 12 / 24. Microwave HEAT (food back in hand) has no unused item (all heat items were used in practice); the fresh microwave item is the stay-inside kind. Tool-only vs manipulation: g-l3-tool-scrub (tool only) against g-l1-pickup-spoon and g-l2-drawer-spatula (manipulation). Cutlery with a Persian purpose phrase is not available fresh. The 8 spare items (see spare_unused) can add L1/L2 items if Arash wants 12.
Items were chosen by rule before any plan or outcome was run; reading text and reference plan to label kinds is part of the rule.
